origin.description: Return the time zone names found in the database.
origin.details: With the bundled text database, the names are the Zone and Link records from the shipped source files, sorted in byte order.
origin.value: A character vector of zone names.

translation.description: Return the zone and link names from the text time zone database.
translation.details: Reads africa, antarctica, asia, australasia, backward, etcetera, europe, pacificnew, northamerica, southamerica, systemv, and leapseconds. Missing files are skipped. The names are sorted as raw bytes.
